title: Burrito Shells
image_alt: Stack of soft homemade flour tortillas

items.name: all-purpose flour, plus a spoonful or two if needed

steps: Stir together the flour and salt in a large bowl.
Cut in the fat until it is fully incorporated into the flour.
Add the warm water and work into a dough. Knead for a couple of minutes. If it is too sticky to handle, add a spoonful or two of flour.
Once worked into a ball, divide into 4 smaller balls.
Let the dough rest until it is workable, about 15–30 minutes.
Roll each ball out thin on a floured cutting board.
Cook on a dry pan over medium heat until it puffs and bubbles, then flip and repeat on the other side.
